# Ego Hygiene

> Tools, ideas, and practices for moving toward balance and harmony.

This website is the Ego Hygiene gateway and storefront. Current artwork previews do not establish approved garments or active purchasing. Real artist merchandise selections remain intentionally empty.

Treat https://egohygiene.io as the canonical source for current public pages. The public catalog browser also contains fictional examples; policy pages are provisional, and ecosystem gateways do not establish separate live deployments.

## Website

- [Ego Hygiene](https://egohygiene.io/): Canonical Ego Hygiene website and starting point for public content.
